page.content:
Bioengineered people built for off-world labor.

How Replicants connects

  • Character: Roy Batty — Roy leads the escaped Nexus-6 group.
  • Character: Officer K — K is himself a replicant.
  • Concept: Nexus-6 — Nexus-6 is Tyrell's four-year replicant generation.
  • Character: Pris — Pris is a Nexus-6 replicant in Roy's group.
  • Location: Off-world colonies — Replicants were built to labor in the off-world colonies.

What is Replicants?

Replicants are manufactured humans — Nexus-6 and later models — used off-world, banned or regulated on Earth, and hunted when they run.

Key threads lead to Roy Batty, Officer K, Nexus-6, Pris and Off-world colonies.
